approach: Static recompilation of the Xbox 360 binary with the ReXGlue SDK, native Linux AppImage and Windows 10/11 folder package, both with the Re-Jeweled launcher
notes: Playable on Linux (Test build 1b): title screen, menus, Classic one-player rounds and results all work with full graphics, PipeWire audio and controller input at a locked 60 fps. No game data is included — supply your own copy. Xbox Live modes (leaderboards, Battle LIVE, Party LIVE) are not available offline. Test build 1b published as a GitHub pre-release on 2026-10-21. A Windows 10/11 x64 build is compiled by GitHub Actions (workflow 'Windows build'; the runtime's D3D12 backend) and is not yet play-tested.
